entries.title: Synthetic guidance: claims stay within the documented design

passages.text: Claims should stay within what the documented selection and design can support. Exploratory interviews can surface reasons and perspectives, but alone they do not establish how common something is in a population.
Observational data can show associations; a causal conclusion needs a design that rules out the main alternative explanations, which should be stated.

entries.title: Synthetic guidance: precision of probability samples

passages.text: For a probability sample, the precision of an estimate depends on the achieved sample size and design effect. This guidance does not apply to opt-in or convenience samples.
Qualitative selection is judged by whether the rationale for who was included fits the purpose and whose perspectives may be missing, not by a minimum number.
